name: ai-assessment-ds-2026
description: AI readiness assessment of dental school departments and courses (Canada, USA, Brazil, China, India)

scripts.docs: node scripts/build-docx.mjs && cd docs && soffice --headless --convert-to pdf ICARB-D-Annual-Survey-Dental-Schools.docx >/dev/null && mkdir -p ../public/downloads && cp ICARB-D-Annual-Survey-Dental-Schools.docx ICARB-D-Annual-Survey-Dental-Schools.pdf ../public/downloads/
scripts.slides: node scripts/build-slides.mjs && cd public/downloads && soffice --headless --convert-to pdf ICARB-D-Survey-Teacher-Slides.pptx >/dev/null
